summary.text: Anne Weisberg is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 108, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Pat Callahan. A Harvard Law School graduate and former environmental lawyer and workplace consultant, she lives in Sherman.

paragraphs.text: Anne Weisberg said in a Ballotpedia survey that she graduated from Harvard Law School and practiced environmental and land use law.
She co-authored Everything a Working Mother Needs to Know, published by Doubleday in 1994, and said she then spent three decades working with business leaders on organizational culture.
She said she retired in 2022 and serves on the board of WE ACT for Environmental Justice and on the volunteer leadership team of Force Multiplier.
Weisberg was the Democratic candidate for District 108 in 2024, when incumbent Pat Callahan defeated her.
In her 2026 survey she said she wants to make energy more affordable, hold the state's publicly held utility accountable, and have the state pay its fair share of school funding.
